`esp-idf-size-json2.json` was generated by `show_summary` from the pinned
[esp-idf-size v1.7.1 formatter](https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf-size/blob/210456b263ea5ab0f5dc48ce7fdb0c263275a9cd/esp_idf_size/ng/format_json.py),
using synthetic Flash Code, DRAM and IRAM sizes and preserving input order.
It exercises the exact upstream JSON schema; it is not firmware build evidence.
The final compiled MC1/MC2 reports include their actual `memory_report` separately.
